topics.name: Automation Occurrence
topics.purpose: Define each due schedule/condition occurrence as explicit evidence separate from automation definition and concrete Runner/operation execution.

semantics.identity_rule: Each occurrence has an explicit identity.
semantics.condition_rule: Condition occurrence/evaluation evidence is exact where applicable.
semantics.execution_rule: Occurrence may create a separate invocation/execution through explicit binding.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Same semantic occurrence is not dispatched repeatedly unless replay policy is explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Occurrence does not grant action authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
